limitations: No CPU gate or real model has been executed by this reviewer. Static parsing/reads cannot certify actual CUDA FP16 behavior, runtime, memory, numerical projector sensitivity, optimizer witness production or whole-study data correctness. Passing the CPU gate will still not be a quality/mechanism result.

The Gram formula measures AA^T versus BB^T. With imperfectly orthogonal columns these are not exact span projectors; FP32 products also impose a cancellation/error floor despite FP64 scalar reductions. Keep raw signed estimates and orthogonality errors, and do not treat a clamped zero as proof of exact unchanged subspace.

A Refresh advantage is a net refactor/protection-reference-update package result.
